plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Hirschmann switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, chassis temperature, power supply status, SFP DDM temperature and optical power, fan state, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 248).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilisation of the Hirschmann switch (HMPRIV-MGMT-SNMP-MIB hmCpuUtilization).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used memory of the Hirschmann switch in bytes (hmMemoryAllocated, KB*1024).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free memory of the Hirschmann switch in bytes (hmMemoryFree, KB*1024).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilisation of the Hirschmann switch, derived as used/(used+free).

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Chassis temperature of the Hirschmann switch in degrees Celsius (hmTemperature).

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Power-supply state of the Hirschmann switch (hmPSState), normalised to 1=normal or notInstalled (empty slots keep a row), 2=failed (abnormal), 3=unknown (gray, no alert).

metrics.name: device_sfp_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: SFP module temperature in degrees Celsius (hmSfpTemperature). Readings outside -40..125 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_sfp_tx_power
metrics.description: SFP internally measured transmit power in microwatts (hmSfpTxPowerInt, Integer32 in 0.1 µW, divided by 10 once in starlark). Values outside 0..1000000 of the raw integer are dropped.

metrics.name: device_sfp_rx_power
metrics.description: SFP internally measured receive power in microwatts (hmSfpRxPowerInt, Integer32 in 0.1 µW, divided by 10 once in starlark). Values outside 0..1000000 of the raw integer are dropped.

metrics.name: device_sfp_rx_power_state
metrics.description: SFP receive-power state (hmSfpRxPowerState): ok(1) maps to 1, warning(2) and alarm(3) map to 2. alarm(3) is a fault code, not unknown. Values the object does not define are dropped.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each chassis fan (hmFanState): ok(1) maps to 1, failed(2) maps to 2. The object does not define unknown, so value 3 is not produced.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
